attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the post

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title of the blog post

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Main content of the blog post in markdown format

attributes.name: excerpt
attributes.description: Short summary of the post for previews

attributes.name: authorId
attributes.description: ID of the user who authored the post

attributes.name: authorName
attributes.description: Display name of the author

attributes.name: publishedDate
attributes.description: Date when the post was published

attributes.name: lastModifiedDate
attributes.description: Date when the post was last modified

attributes.name: featuredImageUrl
attributes.description: URL to the featured image for the post

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Array of tags associated with the post

attributes.name: categories
attributes.description: Array of categories the post belongs to

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Publication status (draft, published, archived)

attributes.name: viewCount
attributes.description: Number of times the post has been viewed

attributes.name: likeCount
attributes.description: Number of likes the post has received

attributes.name: commentCount
attributes.description: Number of comments on the post

attributes.name: readingTimeMinutes
attributes.description: Estimated reading time in minutes

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the comment

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Content of the comment

attributes.name: authorId
attributes.description: ID of the user who authored the comment

attributes.name: authorName
attributes.description: Display name of the comment author

attributes.name: authorAvatarUrl
attributes.description: URL to the avatar image of the comment author

attributes.name: createdDate
attributes.description: Date when the comment was created

attributes.name: lastModifiedDate
attributes.description: Date when the comment was last modified

attributes.name: parentCommentId
attributes.description: ID of the parent comment if this is a reply

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the comment (pending, approved, rejected)

attributes.name: likeCount
attributes.description: Number of likes the comment has received

attributes.name: replyCount
